output.brief:
The Kestria buffering problem is almost certainly caused by the new smart-TV app version 5.2, not by the CDN switch. Smart-TV 5.2 sessions stall about 5.9% of viewing time. Every other client (the 5.1 TV app, web, iOS/Android) sits at 0.6–0.7% on the same Tessaline CDN and the same ISPs. Before the switch, all clients were at 0.5–0.7%. The 5.2 release went live on 9 Oct, the same day as the cutover, which is why the two looked identical on the country-level dashboard. The handball launch came later and didn't change the stall rate, so it isn't the cause. ISP congestion doesn't fit either, since other clients on those ISPs are fine.

Recommendation: don't send the breach notice, withhold fees or roll back to Corvane. Don't mute the alert. Have the app team revert 5.2's adaptive-streaming behaviour in Kestria to the 5.1 settings and pause the wider 5.2 rollout until fixed. Then add app-version and device breakdowns to the dashboard and alerts. Hold off on the free-month offer for cancellers. The 1 Oct price rise also fits the cancellation increase, so buffering isn't shown to be the driver. Confidence is high on the cause, moderate on cancellations.
